stories.title: RBI flags inflation risks from West Asia conflict and El Nino despite resilient economy
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India said inflation pressures could rise because of the war in West Asia and an expected El Nino weather pattern, even though the Indian economy remains resilient. The central bank identified these external factors as potential threats to price stability and said monitoring them will inform future monetary‑policy decisions.

stories.title: Inflation remains high, growth slows, says RBI Governor
stories.summary: RBI Governor Shaktikanta Malhotra told reporters that inflation continues to run above the target band and that the pace of economic growth is decelerating, warning that these twin pressures pose a larger challenge for the central bank in steering monetary policy. He emphasized that addressing inflation while supporting growth will require careful calibration of interest rates.

stories.title: IndusInd Bank posts Rs 1,242 crore net profit on lower provisions
stories.summary: IndusInd Bank reported a net profit of Rs 1,242 crore for the quarter. The result was attributed to lower loan‑loss provisions, which reduced the bank’s expense line. Lower provisioning means a smaller amount was set aside for potential loan defaults.
stories.why: The profit figure signals the bank’s recent financial performance to investors and analysts.

stories.title: Australian MP Helen Haines' condition stabilises after car attack
stories.summary: Independent MP Helen Haines, 65, was struck by a car outside her Wangaratta electorate office in north‑east Victoria on Monday. She underwent emergency surgery that included bilateral leg amputation and was airlifted to Melbourne’s Alfred Hospital. On Saturday the hospital reported her condition had improved from critical to serious but stable.
stories.why: The update informs the public about the health status of a sitting federal parliamentarian and the seriousness of the incident.

stories.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has labelled a gun attack in a Parisian suburb that killed one person and injured five others "a racist terrorist attack". The attack unfolded over some 15 minutes, with the attacker opening fire from his car - first in Trappes, to the south-west of Paris, and then in nearby La Verrière - appearing to target people of migrant origin.

stories.title: India’s forex reserves fall $5 billion to $721.02 billion as of October 16
stories.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by $5 billion to reach $721.02 billion for the week ending October 16. Previously, reserves declined by $8.578 billion to an amount of $726.027 billion.
